cds.title: Colorado State University Common Data Set FY2026 (2025-2026 edition, March 2026) (PDF)

stats.notes: CDS C1/C11/C12 (fall 2025 entering class). CSU does not consider SAT/ACT scores, so C9 percentiles are not reported. CDS gives no residency or international split for applicants/admits (C1 says N/A). Student-faculty ratio is I-2 (fall 2024, 17 to 1). Undergrad enrollment is the B1 total (26,490); the international count is the B2 nonresident total (657). No waitlist; early action only (no early decision).

cost.notes: CDS G1 lists 2024-25 costs (2025-26 costs were not final when the CDS was filed); no separate international tuition, so nonresident tuition applies. G4: 56% of full-time undergraduates pay more because tuition varies by program. H6: 295 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (avg $15,607); the CDS checks both need-based and non-need-based aid as available to nonresidents.
